description: Posts a chat agent's answer into the Slack thread named by the run's own tags -- deterministically, plus a run-failure sensor so a crashed run is never silent.

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: The chat agent asset to depend on and read the answer from (slash-delimited).

slack_bot_token_env_var.label: Slack Bot Token Env Var
slack_bot_token_env_var.description: Env var holding the bot's 'xoxb-...' token. Needs chat:write.

answer_field.label: Answer Field
answer_field.description: Which key of the upstream asset's output dict holds the answer text. Defaults to 'final_answer' (the agent components' own documented output shape) when the upstream value is a dict; used verbatim (str()'d) otherwise.

max_chars_per_message.label: Max Chars Per Message
max_chars_per_message.description: Split or truncate (see on_long_answer) an answer longer than this many characters.

on_long_answer.label: On Long Answer
on_long_answer.description: 'split' (default): post as multiple sequential thread replies, each <= max_chars_per_message. 'truncate': post one reply, cut short with an ellipsis.

include_run_link.label: Include Run Link
include_run_link.description: Append a link to the Dagster run (requires webserver_base_url) to the last reply posted.

webserver_base_url.label: Webserver Base Url
webserver_base_url.description: Base URL of the Dagster webserver (e.g. 'http://localhost:3000' or your Dagster+ deployment URL) -- used to build the run link. Leave unset to omit the link entirely.

monitor_failures.label: Monitor Failures
monitor_failures.description: Also emit {asset_name}_failure_watcher, a run-status sensor that posts a short error reply for ANY failed run carrying slack/channel + slack/thread_ts tags -- so a crashed run is never silent in the channel. Set false to handle failure notification some other way.

error_message_template.label: Error Message Template
error_message_template.description: Template for the failure-path reply. Placeholder: {error}.

deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime).
deps.label: Deps

owners.description: Asset owners — team names (team:analytics) or email addresses.
owners.label: Owners

asset_tags.description: Key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog, e.g. {"domain": "finance"}.
asset_tags.label: Asset Tags

kinds.description: Asset kinds shown in the Dagster catalog (e.g. snowflake, python). Auto-inferred from component name if empty.
kinds.label: Kinds

receipts_db_path.label: Receipts Db Path
receipts_db_path.description: SQLite file path -- the SAME receipts_db_path a knowledge_search_server/hybrid_knowledge_search_server the agent calls is configured with (and which must also have run_id_template set, the default, so its receipts carry this run's dagster_run_id). When set, after posting, this asset looks up every receipt this run produced and links them to the posted Slack message(s) -- so a later rating (watch_reactions below, or any other feedback path) can find the exact receipt_id to record an outcome against, instead of an agent having to end its reply with 'ref: <receipt_id>' and have that parsed back out of the text. Best-effort: a lookup failure here never fails the reply post itself.

watch_reactions.label: Watch Reactions
watch_reactions.description: Also emit {asset_name}_rating_watcher, a sensor that polls reactions on every Slack message this asset has linked to a receipt (via receipts_db_path, which must also be set) and records a thumbs_up/thumbs_down outcome against each linked receipt_id -- the reactor's resolved email (see resolve_rater_email) becomes the outcome's `outcome_ref`, so changing a reaction later supersedes the earlier rating instead of double-counting (the same outcome_ref-supersede behavior record_feedback already has). Needs the `reactions:read` bot scope.

positive_reaction.label: Positive Reaction
positive_reaction.description: Slack reaction name (as reactions.get returns it, e.g. '+1' for 👍) that records a thumbs_up outcome. Only used when watch_reactions is true.

negative_reaction.label: Negative Reaction
negative_reaction.description: Slack reaction name (e.g. '-1' for 👎) that records a thumbs_down outcome. Only used when watch_reactions is true.

rating_poll_interval_seconds.label: Rating Poll Interval Seconds
rating_poll_interval_seconds.description: Minimum seconds between rating_watcher ticks. Only used when watch_reactions is true.

rating_lookback_messages.label: Rating Lookback Messages
rating_lookback_messages.description: Most-recently-linked (channel, message_ts) pairs to keep polling for reactions, and the cursor's bound. Only used when watch_reactions is true.

resolve_rater_email.label: Resolve Rater Email
resolve_rater_email.description: Resolve the reacting user's Slack user id to an email address (needs users:read.email) before using it as the outcome's outcome_ref. When false, the raw Slack user id is used instead. Only used when watch_reactions is true.

report_files_dir.label: Report Files Dir
report_files_dir.description: Local directory root -- the SAME files_dir a report_tools_server this agent calls is configured with. When set, after posting the answer, this asset reads this run's manifest (written by report_tools_server's make_chart/make_pdf/make_docx/make_xlsx) and uploads every file it recorded into the same thread with files_upload_v2 (needs the `files:write` bot scope). Files may contain data the agent read, so the same people who can see the channel can see them -- posted filenames are recorded in this asset's own materialization metadata. Best-effort: an upload failure here never fails the already-posted answer.

update_reaction_on_completion.label: Update Reaction On Completion
update_reaction_on_completion.description: On success, remove ack_reaction and add done_reaction to the ORIGINAL triggering message (the slack/message_ts tag slack_agent_request_sensor sets) -- so a 20-30s answer doesn't just look stuck at its acknowledgement reaction forever. On a failed run, {asset_name}_failure_watcher adds error_reaction instead (ack_reaction is still removed first). Needs reactions:write (same scope watch_reactions reads with, just the write half). Best-effort: a reaction-swap failure never fails the reply itself.

ack_reaction.label: Ack Reaction
ack_reaction.description: The reaction slack_agent_request_sensor posted on pickup (must match its own acknowledgement_reaction) -- removed on completion. Only used when update_reaction_on_completion is true.

done_reaction.label: Done Reaction
done_reaction.description: Reaction added to the original message once the reply posts successfully. Only used when update_reaction_on_completion is true.

error_reaction.label: Error Reaction
error_reaction.description: Reaction added to the original message when the run fails (added by {asset_name}_failure_watcher). Only used when update_reaction_on_completion is true.
